activities.title: Creek Watch Sensor Network
activities.description: Built and deployed 9 solar-powered Arduino sensors measuring turbidity, temperature, and dissolved oxygen in Mill Creek; publish an open data dashboard used by the township conservation commission.

activities.title: Policy Debate
activities.description: State quarterfinalist; wrote the team's energy and water policy case files; coach novice debaters on research and cross-examination.

activities.title: Downtown Heat Island Map
activities.description: Built a bike-mounted temperature logger and mapped summer heat across downtown Lakeview; presented the map and tree-cover recommendations to city council.

activities.title: Volunteer Interpreter
activities.organization: Lakeview Township and Community Health Fair
activities.description: Interpret for Spanish-speaking families at township meetings on stormwater fees and at the annual community health fair.

activities.title: Summer Intern, County Soil and Water Conservation District
activities.description: Mapped stormwater outfalls with GIS, sampled streams after storms, and helped draft a green-infrastructure grant application.

activities.title: Jazz Band
activities.description: Lead trumpet in the school big band and a student combo; arrange charts for the combo; All-State Jazz Ensemble alternate.

activities.title: Community Bike Co-op
activities.description: Repair donated bikes and teach basic maintenance at a co-op that gives refurbished bikes to refugee families.
